units.source_text: 山庄中处处打扫干净，一切收拾停当。

en.t: Every part of the mountain villa had been swept clean, and all the arrangements were in order.
The carriage drew up near the eaves and stopped.

units.source_text: 派来迎接的都是四位、五位官员，人数甚多。

en.t: Those sent to escort her were all officials of the fourth and fifth ranks, and there were a great many of them.

units.source_text: 匂亲王定要亲迎，但因铺张太甚，反多不便之处，因此只取私下迎娶的方式。

en.t: Prince Niou had insisted on coming to receive her himself, but since too grand a display would only create many inconveniences, they chose instead to make the wedding escort private.

units.source_text: 匂亲王在宫中等待，不胜心焦。

en.t: Prince Niou waited in the palace, unable to contain his impatience.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言也派了许多人来参加行列。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, also sent many people to join the procession.

units.source_text: 此次迎娶，大体事务由匂亲王主办。

en.t: For this wedding escort, Prince Niou took charge of the main arrangements.

units.source_text: 内部种种细节，则概由薰中纳言调度，照顾无微不至。

en.t: All the various inner details, however, were directed by Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, whose care left nothing overlooked.

units.source_text: 室内众侍女及室外奉迎人员都催促动身：“天色将暮了！”

en.t: The ladies inside and the attendants waiting outside all urged them to set out, saying, "It will soon be dark!"

units.source_text: 二女公子心情慌乱，不知前途到达的是何等去处，只觉得心情异常悲伤。

en.t: The second young lady was in turmoil, not knowing what sort of place lay ahead of her, and she felt only an extraordinary sadness.

units.source_text: 和二女公子同车的侍女大辅君吟诗云：

en.t: The lady-in-waiting Taifu no Kimi, who rode in the same carriage as the second young lady, recited this poem:
